News archive New Zealand’s Cyber Security Strategy 2026 - 2030 published News Issue date: Fri 27 Feb 2026 The New Zealand Government has released New Zealand’s Cyber Security Strategy 2026 - 2030 . Building a safer and more resilient New Zealand News Issue date: Thu 27 Nov 2025 The Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet, and the Ministry for the Environment have developed a Long-term Insights Briefing on a nationally important topic: building New Zealand's long-term resilience to hazards, such as severe weather, pandemic Five Country Ministerial 2025 News Issue date: Wed 10 Sep 2025 Five Country Ministerial 2025: Communiqué We, the Home Affairs, Interior and Security Ministers of Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States (the ‘Five Countries’) convened in person under the United Kingdom’s cha Help shape our Long-term Insights Briefing on building resilience to hazards News Issue date: Wed 6 Aug 2025 How can New Zealand build long-term resilience to hazards, such as severe weather, pandemics, volcanic activity, and earthquakes? NEMA hosting to transfer to DIA in 2025 News Issue date: Thu 31 Jul 2025 NEMA hosting to transfer to DIA in 2025 The hosting responsibilities for the National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) will transfer from the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (DPMC) to the Department of Internal Affairs (DIA) from Five Country Ministerial 2024 News Issue date: Mon 21 Oct 2024 Five Country Ministerial Communiqué We, the Home Affairs, Interior, Security and Immigration Ministers of Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States (the ‘Five Countries’) remain steadfast in our commitment to Five Country Ministerial Statement on Bridging Government Efforts and Elevating Survivors’ Voices News Issue date: Mon 21 Oct 2024 Preamble We, the Home Affairs, Interior, Security and Immigration Ministers of Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States (the ‘Five Countries’) , recognize the importance of drawing in the voices and experien Five Country Ministerial Statement on Irregular Migration News Issue date: Mon 21 Oct 2024 The Five Countries have a long and proud tradition of welcoming migrants and providing protection to the most vulnerable people across the world. Release of Multi-Stakeholder Group report on resilience to disinformation News Issue date: Wed 19 Jun 2024 The Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet convened a multi-stakeholder group in July 2023 to provide practical advice from outside government on how to understand and respond to disinformation in Aotearoa New Zealand. Fund launched for community-based initiatives to strengthen Aotearoa’s resilience to disinformation News Issue date: Thu 14 Sep 2023 A one-off fund to provide financial support for community-based initiatives that build resilience against the harms of disinformation has been est Aotearoa New Zealand's first National Security Strategy launched News Issue date: Fri 4 Aug 2023 Aotearoa New Zealand’s first National Security Strategy has been launched on 4 August 2023. Secure Together Tō Tātou Korowai Manaaki will guide New Zealand’s approach to national security over the coming years. Expert group launched to counter disinformation News Issue date: Mon 24 Jul 2023 Nine specialists from across New Zealand have been appointed to a multi-stakeholder group to provide advice to Government on countering disinformation. Lifting the resilience of New Zealand’s critical infrastructure News Issue date: Tue 13 Jun 2023 Recent events, such as Cyclone Gabrielle, have demonstrated the interconnected nature of New Zealand’s infrastructure system, where outages in one sector can quickly cascade across the entire system. Cabinet Manual – 2023 edition published News Issue date: Thu 20 Apr 2023 The 2023 edition of the Cabinet Manual has been published. Appointment of new Secretary of the Cabinet and Clerk of the Executive Council News Issue date: Fri 4 Nov 2022 Rachel Hayward has been appointed Secretary of the Cabinet and Clerk of the Executive Council. The appointment was effective from 2 November 2022. Boards announced for interim Māori Health Authority and Health New Zealand News Issue date: Thu 23 Sep 2021 The Minister of Health, Andrew Little, and Associate Minister of Health, Peeni Henare, announced appointments to the boards of interim entities, the Māori Health Authority and Health New Zealand. New COVID-19 business unit for DPMC News Issue date: Wed 1 Jul 2020 From July 1 2020, the COVID-19 All-of-Government Response Group has formally become a business unit of the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet. Child and Youth Wellbeing Strategy launched News Issue date: Thu 29 Aug 2019 The Child and Youth Wellbeing Strategy was launched on 29 August 2019, at Kaitao school in Rotorua. The Strategy sets out a shared understanding of what’s important for child and youth wellbeing, what government is doing, and how others can help. The Royal Commission: Former and current employees News Issue date: Wed 14 Aug 2019 The Royal Commission invites current and former employees and contractors of the following State sector agencies to approach it if they believe that they can assist its inquiry: Feedback opens for Draft Disposal Schedule News Issue date: Mon 19 Nov 2018 A draft disposal schedule for the NZSIS, GCSB, and National Security Group of DPMC is open for feedback from 19 November-10 December 2018. PIF follow-up review for core New Zealand Intelligence Community News Issue date: Thu 30 Aug 2018 A Performance Improvement Framework (PIF) follow-up review of the New Zealand Intelligence Community has been released. Whole of Government Report: Lessons from the Canterbury earthquake sequence News Issue date: Sun 30 Jul 2017 The report titled Lessons from the Canterbury earthquake sequence provides a whole-of-government perspective on the lessons from the Government’s recovery efforts from the Canterbury earthquake disaster. Minister releases ChristChurch Cathedral Reinstatement Offer News Issue date: Tue 4 Jul 2017 The Minister supporting Greater Christchurch Regeneration (Nicky Wagner) released the ChristChurch Cathedral Reinstatement Offer today. More information on the Cathedral Working Group website Ministerial Review: Better Responses to Natural Disasters and Other Emergencies in New Zealand News Issue date: Fri 30 Jun 2017 Submissions close on 7 July for the Ministerial Review: Better Responses to Natural Disasters and Other Emergencies in New Zealand . National Security System in 2016: Speech by Howard Broad News Issue date: Wed 21 Sep 2016 At the Massey University National Security Conference on 30 August 2016, Howard Broad gave the following speech. Howard Broad is the Deputy Chief Executive of the Security and Intelligence Group of DPMC Advisory: Budget 2016 - NZ Intelligence community News Issue date: Thu 14 Jul 2016 The New Zealand Intelligence Community (NZIC) received new operating and capital funding of $178.7 million over four years as part of Budget 2016. Residential Red Zone Survey report published News Issue date: Fri 29 Apr 2016 Greater Christchurch Group has released the report of a survey conducted by CERA of more than 2000 property owners who accepted a Crown offer to evaluate wellbeing outcomes, and to determine whether the Crown's recovery objectives had been met. The survey and report were carried out by Nielsen Research. Future Christchurch Update News Issue date: Tue 12 Apr 2016 Future Christchurch Update is a monthly publication of information and updates on the greater Christchurch recovery and regeneration. It’s produced jointly by CERA and Christchurch City Council, and delivered to over 178,000 letterboxes across greater Christchurch. From May 2016, it’ll be produced by the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (DPMC), in partnership with Christchurch City Council. Media statement: New Director for Greater Christchurch Group News Issue date: Fri 1 Apr 2016 1 April 2016 Experienced public servant Kelvan Smith has been appointed Director of the Greater Christchurch Group of the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (DPMC). Independent Review of Intelligence and Security News Issue date: Thu 10 Mar 2016 The 2015 Independent Review of Intelligence and Security was tabled in Parliament on 9 March 2016. Media Statement: Director of new Canterbury Group announced News Issue date: Tue 17 Nov 2015 17 November 2015 Michelle Mitchell has been appointed Director of the Canterbury Group within the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (DPMC). Update on DPMC's 2015-2019 Strategic Intentions News Issue date: Mon 3 Aug 2015 DPMC's latest strategic intentions were published on 1 August 2014.
